features.name: Fighting Style
features.text: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

from.name: Archery
from.text: +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

from.name: Defense
from.text: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

from.name: Dueling
from.text: When you're holding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

from.name: Great Weapon Fighting
from.text: When you roll damage for a Melee weapon you're holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.

from.name: Protection
from.text: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll.

from.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
from.text: When you make an extra attack as a Bonus Action, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina. As a Bonus Action, you can regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. You have two uses, regaining one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial melee weapons of your choice.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Magic action.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.text: When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of Second Wind to add 1d10 to the check, potentially turning it into a success.

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.text: You gain a Fighter subclass of your choice.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.text: Whenever you activate your Second Wind with a Bonus Action, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.text: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.text: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and on Strength (Athletics) checks. In addition, immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Arcane Archer
features.text: Elven-derived archery that weaves magic into arrows to produce supernatural effects.

features.name: Battle Master
features.text: A student of martial technique, combining honed combat skill with academic study of battle itself.

features.name: Cavalier
features.text: Excels at mounted combat and at guarding those in their charge from harm.

features.name: Echo Knight
features.text: Uses dunamis to summon fading echoes of unrealized timelines to fight alongside them.

features.name: Eldritch Knight
features.text: Combines martial mastery with arcane study — spells that complement and extend combat skill.

features.name: Psi Warrior
features.text: Awakens psionic power to infuse weapon strikes, lash out telekinetically, and form barriers of mental force.

features.name: Rune Knight
features.text: Enhances martial prowess with giant-derived magic runes applied to equipment.

features.name: Samurai
features.text: Draws on an implacable fighting spirit; a Samurai's foes must yield or die fighting.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You know 3 cantrips and keep a spellbook of level 1+ spells (starts with 6, +2 per level after 1st); prepare a growing subset to cast. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots per the Wizard table, all regained on a long rest. An Arcane Focus or your spellbook can serve as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.text: You can cast any Ritual-tagged spell in your spellbook as a ritual without it being prepared, reading from the book.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.text: On a short rest, recover expended spell slots totaling no more than half your Wizard level (round up), none level 6+. Once per long rest.

features.name: Scholar
features.text: Expertise in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion (must already be proficient).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.text: On a short rest, swap one prepared level 1+ spell for another from your spellbook.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.text: Choose a level 1 and a level 2 action-cast spell from your spellbook; always prepared, castable at their lowest level for free. Swappable on a long rest.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.text: Choose two level 3 spells from your spellbook; always prepared, each castable once for free per short/long rest.

features.name: School of Abjuration
features.text: Magic that blocks, banishes, or protects — ending harmful effects and closing planar portals.

features.name: School of Bladesinging
features.text: An elf-originated tradition blending swordplay and dance with devastating arcane attacks.

features.name: Chronurgy Magic
features.text: Manipulates time itself, bending its flow using anticipatory dunamis energy.

features.name: School of Conjuration
features.text: Produces objects and creatures from thin air, and later grants mastery of teleportation.

features.name: School of Divination
features.text: Parts the veils of space, time, and consciousness to see clearly into past, present, and future.

features.name: School of Enchantment
features.text: Hones the ability to magically entrance and beguile people and monsters.

features.name: School of Evocation
features.text: Focuses on powerful elemental effects — cold, flame, thunder, lightning, and acid.

features.name: Graviturgy Magic
features.text: Bends and manipulates the energy of gravity, drawing bodies together or driving them apart.

features.name: School of Illusion
features.text: Dazzles the senses and befuddles the mind, making the impossible seem real.

features.name: School of Necromancy
features.text: Explores the cosmic forces of life, death, and undeath, manipulating animating energy.

features.name: Order of Scribes
features.text: The most bookish wizards, magically awakening their spellbook into a trusted companion.

features.name: School of Transmutation
features.text: Modifies energy and matter, altering both physical forms and mental qualities.

features.name: War Magic
features.text: Blends evocation and abjuration to train wizards for war, striking hard while shoring up defense.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You know 3 cantrips and prepare a growing list of level 1+ spells from the Cleric list; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots per the Cleric table, all regained on a long rest.

features.name: Divine Order
features.text: Choose Protector (martial/heavy-armor training) or Thaumaturge (extra cantrip, Wis-based Arcana/Religion checks).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Channel divine energy twice (regains 1 per short rest, all per long rest, +1 use at higher levels) to fuel effects, starting with Divine Spark and Turn Undead.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.text: When Turning Undead, deal radiant damage (Wis modifier d8s, min 1) to Undead that fail their save.

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.text: Choose Divine Strike (+1d8 damage on a weapon hit, once per turn) or Potent Spellcasting (add Wisdom modifier to cantrip damage).

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.text: Magic action: cast any level 5-or-lower Cleric spell (no reaction casting time) without a slot or material components. Once per long rest.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.text: Your Blessed Strikes choice improves: Divine Strike extra damage becomes 2d8, or Potent Spellcasting cantrip damage also grants temporary HP equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.text: Divine Intervention can now choose Wish; doing so locks out Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 long rests.

features.name: Arcana Domain
features.text: Gods of magic itself — arcane knowledge treated as sacred responsibility or raw power.

features.name: Death Domain
features.text: Concerned with the forces that cause death and the negative energy behind undeath.

features.name: Forge Domain
features.text: Patrons of artisans who work metal, transforming raw ore into wondrous, potent creations.

features.name: Grave Domain
features.text: Watches the line between life and death, putting wandering spirits to rest and delaying death when needed.

features.name: Knowledge Domain
features.text: Gods who value learning above all — gathering, guarding, or trading in secrets and lore.

features.name: Life Domain
features.text: Focuses on the positive energy sustaining all life — masters of healing many hurts.

features.name: Light Domain
features.text: Divine power of blazing fire and revelation, chasing away lies and burning back darkness.

features.name: Nature Domain
features.text: As varied as the natural world — champions who advance the interests of a nature god.

features.name: Order Domain
features.text: Discipline and devotion to society and law, enforcing obedience above individual will.

features.name: Peace Domain
features.text: Inspires conflict resolution and stands against forces that would prevent peace.

features.name: Solidarity Domain (PSA)
features.text: Instills unity of purpose in Oketra's acolytes, forging them into a single, purposeful crop. Sourced from Plane Shift: Amonkhet, an official but non-sourcebook WotC PDF.

features.name: Strength Domain (PSA)
features.text: Rhonas's teaching that strength must be built through practice, not academic instruction. Sourced from Plane Shift: Amonkhet, an official but non-sourcebook WotC PDF.

features.name: Ambition Domain (PSA)
features.text: Bontu's creed that supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife, whatever the cost. Sourced from Plane Shift: Amonkhet, an official but non-sourcebook WotC PDF.

features.name: Zeal Domain (PSA)
features.text: Hazoret's relentless fervor and dedication, taught best by example. Sourced from Plane Shift: Amonkhet, an official but non-sourcebook WotC PDF.

features.name: Tempest Domain
features.text: Governs storm, sea, and sky — gods of lightning, thunder, earthquakes, and swift justice.

features.name: Trickery Domain
features.text: Magic of deception, illusion, and stealth — puncturing pride and mocking tyrants.

features.name: Twilight Domain
features.text: Guards the transition from light into darkness, ensuring the dark is a comfort, not a terror.

features.name: War Domain
features.text: Excels in battle, inspiring valor or offering acts of violence as prayer.

features.name: Rage
features.text: Bonus action (not while wearing Heavy armor): for the rest of the turn and while it continues, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing damage, advantage on Str checks and saves, a bonus to Str-based weapon/unarmed damage (scales with level), and you can't concentrate or cast spells. Lasts until the end of your next turn, extended by attacking, forcing a save, or a bonus action; ends early if you don Heavy armor or are incapacitated. Limited uses per long rest (scales with level), regains one per short rest.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.text: While not wearing armor, your base AC equals 10 + Dex modifier + Con modifier. A shield can still be used.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: You can use the weapon mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial melee weapons of your choice, swappable on a long rest.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.text: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, unless incapacitated.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.text: On your first attack roll of the turn, you may attack recklessly: advantage on your Strength attack rolls until your next turn, but attacks against you also have advantage.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.text: Gain proficiency in one more skill from the Barbarian skill list. While raging, you can use Strength in place of the normal ability for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.text: Speed +10 feet while not wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.text: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.text: As part of the bonus action to enter Rage, move up to half your speed.

features.name: Brutal Strike
features.text: Forgoing advantage from Reckless Attack on one Strength attack deals +1d10 damage and applies a chosen effect (push 15 ft, or reduce target's speed by 15 ft until your next turn).

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.text: Dropping to 0 HP while raging lets you make a DC 10 Con save (DC +5 each use since your last rest) to instead go to HP equal to twice your Barbarian level.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.text: Two more Brutal Strike effects: impose disadvantage on the target's next save and deny it opportunity attacks, or grant +5 to the next attack roll made against it.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.text: Regain all Rage uses on rolling Initiative (once per long rest). Rage now lasts 10 minutes without needing to be extended, ending only on being knocked unconscious or donning Heavy armor.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike (2d10)
features.text: Brutal Strike extra damage increases to 2d10, and you can apply two Brutal Strike effects at once.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.text: If your Strength check or save total is less than your Strength score, use the score instead.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.text: Strength and Constitution scores each increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

features.name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
features.text: Rage summons the spirits of departed ancestors to protect you and your allies from harm.

features.name: Path of the Battlerager
features.text: A dwarven tradition of fighting in spiked armor, striking with the body itself while raging.

features.name: Path of the Beast
features.text: Rage manifests a bestial transformation — natural weapons and other feral traits burst forth from within.

features.name: Path of the Berserker
features.text: A path of untrammeled fury directed primarily toward violence, thrilling in the chaos of battle.

features.name: Path of the Giant
features.text: Draws strength from the same primal forces as giants, growing in size and elemental power while raging.

features.name: Path of the Storm Herald
features.text: Rage taps the forces of nature into a mantle of primal magic swirling around the barbarian.

features.name: Path of the Totem Warrior
features.text: A spiritual path accepting a totem spirit animal as guide and protector, adding magical fuel to your rage.

features.name: Path of Wild Magic
features.text: Rage channels the beauty and chaos of the Feywild and other wild-magic-suffused realms.

features.name: Path of the Zealot
features.text: Rage is experienced as an ecstatic episode of divine union with a god or pantheon, granting divine boons.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.text: Bonus action: give a creature within 60 ft that can see/hear you a Bardic Inspiration die (d6, growing to d8 at 5, d10 at 10, d12 at 15). Within the hour, it can add the die to one failed D20 Test. Uses per long rest = Cha modifier (min 1).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You know 2 cantrips and prepare a growing list of level 1+ spells from the Bard list; Charisma is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots per the Bard table, all regained on a long rest.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Expertise (double proficiency bonus) in two skill proficiencies of your choice. Two more at level 9.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.text: Add half your proficiency bonus (round down) to any ability check using a skill you lack proficiency in.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.text: Bardic Inspiration uses now refresh on a short or long rest, and you can spend a spell slot (no action) to regain one use.

features.name: Countercharm
features.text: Reaction: if you or a creature within 30 ft fails a save against being Charmed or Frightened, force a reroll with advantage.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.text: When your number of prepared spells increases, you may choose the new spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists as well.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.text: On rolling Initiative, regain Bardic Inspiration uses up to 2 if you have fewer.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Words of Creation
features.text: Always have Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill prepared; each can target a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

features.name: College of Creation
features.text: Draws on the primeval Song of Creation through dance, music, and poetry.

features.name: College of Eloquence
features.text: Masters of oratory, blending logic and theatrical wordplay to win over skeptics.

features.name: College of Glamour
features.text: Weaves beguiling Feywild magic of beauty and terror into performances.

features.name: College of Lore
features.text: Collects spells and secrets from diverse sources, sharing lore in libraries and courts.

features.name: College of Spirits
features.text: Conjures spiritual embodiments of tales, legends, and histories using occult trappings.

features.name: College of Swords
features.text: Entertainer-warriors ("blades") who perform daring feats of weapon prowess.

features.name: College of Valor
features.text: Storytellers preserving the memory of great heroes, inspiring new generations to greatness.

features.name: College of Whispers
features.text: Uses a bard's welcome to uncover secrets and turn them against others through extortion.

features.name: Druidic
features.text: You know Druidic and always have Speak with Animals prepared.

features.name: Primal Order
features.text: Choose Magician (extra cantrip, Int-based Arcana/Nature checks) or Warden (extra armor/weapon training).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You know 2 cantrips and prepare a growing list of level 1+ spells from the Druid list; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots per the Druid table, all regained on a long rest.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.text: Magic action: expend a spell slot or Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar (Fey, no material components; disappears on a long rest).

features.name: Wild Shape
features.text: Bonus action: shape-shift into a known Beast form (CR/type limits grow with level) for up to half your Druid level in hours. 2 uses, regaining 1 per short rest, all on a long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Wild Resurgence
features.text: Once per turn, gain a Wild Shape use by expending a spell slot, or gain a level-1 spell slot by expending a Wild Shape use (once per long rest for the latter).

features.name: Elemental Fury
features.text: Choose Potent Spellcasting (add Wisdom modifier to cantrip damage) or Primal Strike (Wild Shape attacks deal +1d8 damage of your form's type).

features.name: Improved Elemental Fury
features.text: Your Elemental Fury choice improves: Potent Spellcasting cantrip range +300 ft, or Primal Strike extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.text: While Wild Shaped, you can cast spells (except those with a costly or consumed material component).

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Archdruid
features.text: Regain a Wild Shape use on rolling Initiative; convert unused Wild Shape uses into a spell slot (2 levels per use) once per long rest; age at 1/10th the normal rate.

features.name: Circle of Stars
features.text: Druids who track constellations to harness the powers of the cosmos.

features.name: Circle of Spores
features.text: Druids who find beauty in decay, seeing fungi as the transformation of death into new life.

features.name: Circle of Dreams
features.text: Druids tied to the Feywild, whose magic mends wounds and brings dreamy wonder.

features.name: Circle of the Land
features.text: Mystics and sages safeguarding ancient knowledge and rites tied to a chosen terrain.

features.name: Circle of the Moon
features.text: Druids who draw on lunar magic to transform into powerful beasts to guard the wilds.

features.name: Circle of the Shepherd
features.text: Druids devoted to protecting the natural world's creatures, summoning spirits to aid them.

features.name: Circle of Wildfire
features.text: Druids who master the balance of destruction and rebirth through primal fire, bonded to a fire spirit.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.text: While unarmed or using only Monk weapons (Simple melee and Light Martial melee) with no armor/shield, gain bonus unarmed-strike/monk-weapon combat options keyed to Dex.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.text: While not wearing armor or a shield, base AC = 10 + Dex modifier + Wis modifier.

features.name: Monk's Focus
features.text: Focus Points (scaling with level) fuel Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind. Regain all on a short or long rest. Save DC = 8 + Wis modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.text: Speed increases (scaling with level) while not wearing armor or a shield.

features.name: Uncanny Metabolism
features.text: On rolling Initiative, regain all Focus Points and heal Martial Arts die + Monk level HP. Once per long rest.

features.name: Deflect Attacks
features.text: Reaction on being hit by a bludgeoning/piercing/slashing attack: reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dex modifier + Monk level; if reduced to 0, spend 1 Focus Point to redirect force at a nearby creature (Dex save or take 2x Martial Arts die + Dex modifier damage).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.text: Reaction on falling: reduce fall damage by 5 x Monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.text: Once per turn on hitting with a Monk weapon or unarmed strike, spend 1 Focus Point to force a Con save; failure stuns until the start of your next turn, success halves the target's speed and grants advantage on the next attack against it.

features.name: Empowered Strikes
features.text: Unarmed strike damage can be Force damage instead of its normal type.

features.name: Evasion
features.text: On a Dexterity save for half damage, take none on a success and half on a failure (not while incapacitated).

features.name: Acrobatic Movement
features.text: While unarmored and shieldless, move along vertical surfaces and across liquids without falling.

features.name: Heightened Focus
features.text: Flurry of Blows can make 3 strikes instead of 2; Patient Defense grants 2 Martial Arts dice of temporary HP; Step of the Wind can bring a willing Large-or-smaller creature with you.

features.name: Self-Restoration
features.text: At the end of each turn, remove Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned from yourself; forgoing food/drink causes no Exhaustion.

features.name: Deflect Energy
features.text: Deflect Attacks now works against any damage type, not just bludgeoning/piercing/slashing.

features.name: Disciplined Survivor
features.text: Proficiency in all saving throws; spend 1 Focus Point to reroll a failed save.

features.name: Perfect Focus
features.text: On rolling Initiative (if not using Uncanny Metabolism), regain Focus Points up to 4 if you have 3 or fewer.

features.name: Superior Defense
features.text: Start of turn: spend 3 Focus Points for resistance to all damage except Force for 1 minute or until incapacitated.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Body and Mind
features.text: Dexterity and Wisdom scores each increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

features.name: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
features.text: Monks who emulate dragons, resonating their spirit with draconic might.

features.name: Way of the Astral Self
features.text: Monks who manifest their ki as an astral self, a spectral force of protection or disorder.

features.name: Way of the Drunken Master
features.text: Uses jerky, unpredictable drunkard movements to conceal a carefully executed combat dance.

features.name: Way of the Four Elements
features.text: Harnesses ki to bend the four elements to the monk's will as an extension of the body.

features.name: Way of the Kensei
features.text: Trains relentlessly with a chosen weapon until it becomes an extension of the body.

features.name: Way of the Long Death
features.text: Obsessed with the meaning and mechanics of dying, yielding a deadly fighting style.

features.name: Way of Mercy
features.text: Manipulates life force to heal the needy or grant a swift end as an act of mercy.

features.name: Way of the Open Hand
features.text: Ultimate masters of unarmed and armed martial arts, pushing, tripping, and healing with ki.

features.name: Way of Shadow
features.text: A tradition of stealth and subterfuge, producing spies and assassins skilled in shadow magic.

features.name: Way of the Sun Soul
features.text: Channels life energy into searing bolts of light through focused meditation.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.text: A healing pool of 5 x Paladin level HP, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: restore HP from the pool to a creature you touch, or spend 5 HP from the pool to cure the Poisoned condition.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You prepare a growing list of level 1+ spells from the Paladin list; Charisma is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots per the Paladin table, all regained on a long rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: You can use the weapon mastery properties of two kinds of weapons you're proficient with, swappable on a long rest.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.text: Gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Paladin's Smite
features.text: Always have Divine Smite prepared, castable once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Channel divine energy twice (regains 1 per short rest, all per long rest, +1 use at level 11) to fuel effects, starting with Divine Sense.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Faithful Steed
features.text: Always have Find Steed prepared, castable once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.text: 10-ft emanation (inactive if incapacitated): you and allies within it add your Charisma modifier (min +1) to saving throws.

features.name: Abjure Foes
features.text: Magic action, one Channel Divinity use: creatures equal to your Cha modifier (min 1) within 60 ft make a Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute or until damaged.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.text: You and allies in your Aura of Protection are immune to the Frightened condition.

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.text: Melee weapon or unarmed attacks deal +1d8 radiant damage on a hit.

features.name: Restoring Touch
features.text: Lay on Hands can also remove Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned (5 HP from the pool per condition).

features.name: Aura Expansion
features.text: Aura of Protection becomes a 30-foot emanation.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients
features.text: As old as the first elves — cherishes light, beauty, and life over principles of honor and justice.

features.name: Oath of Conquest
features.text: Seeks glory in battle and the total subjugation of enemies, crushing the forces of chaos.

features.name: Oath of Glory
features.text: Believes paladin and companions are destined for heroism, training diligently for when destiny calls.

features.name: Oath of the Crown
features.text: Sworn to civilization and law, standing as watchful guardians of nation or sovereign.

features.name: Oath of Devotion
features.text: Binds to the ideals of justice and order — the archetypal knight in shining armor.

features.name: Oath of Redemption
features.text: Uses violence only as a last resort, believing any person can be redeemed.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance
features.text: A solemn commitment to punish those who commit grievously evil acts.

features.name: Oathbreaker
features.text: An evil paladin (3rd level or higher) who has broken their sacred oath to pursue dark ambition.

features.name: Oath of the Watchers
features.text: Binds paladins to protect mortal realms from extraplanar predations, ever vigilant for otherworldly influence.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.text: Always have Hunter's Mark prepared, castable without a slot a number of times (scaling with level) per long rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: You can use the weapon mastery properties of two kinds of weapons you're proficient with, swappable on a long rest.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.text: Gain Expertise in one skill proficiency, and learn two languages of your choice.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.text: Gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You prepare a growing list of level 1+ spells from the Ranger list; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots per the Ranger table, all regained on a long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Roving
features.text: Speed +10 feet while not wearing Heavy armor; gain a Climb Speed and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Gain Expertise in two skill proficiencies of your choice.

features.name: Tireless
features.text: Magic action (uses = Wis modifier, min 1, per long rest): gain 1d8 + Wis modifier temporary HP. Also reduce Exhaustion by 1 on finishing a short rest.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.text: Taking damage can't break your concentration on Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.text: Bonus action (uses = Wis modifier, min 1, per long rest): turn invisible until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Precise Hunter
features.text: Advantage on attack rolls against the creature marked by your Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.text: Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.text: Hunter's Mark's damage die becomes a d10 instead of d6.

features.name: Beast Master
features.text: Forms a mystical bond with a primal beast companion, drawing on deep connection to nature.

features.name: Drakewarden
features.text: Bonds with a draconic spirit that manifests as a growing drake companion, eventually rideable.

features.name: Fey Wanderer
features.text: Touched by fey mystique — joyful mirth for allies, dreadful fury for foes.

features.name: Gloom Stalker
features.text: At home in darkness, wielding Shadowfell-drawn magic against enemies that lurk within it.

features.name: Horizon Walker
features.text: Guards the world against planar threats, watching over portals to other planes.

features.name: Hunter
features.text: Stalks prey in the wilds, protecting nature and people from forces that would destroy them.

features.name: Monster Slayer
features.text: Dedicated to hunting vampires, dragons, evil fey, fiends, and other magical threats.

features.name: Swarmkeeper
features.text: Bonds with a swarm of nature spirits that fights alongside the ranger.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Expertise (double proficiency bonus) in two skill proficiencies. Two more at level 6.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.text: Once per turn, +1d6 damage (scaling with level) on a hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have advantage, or an ally is within 5 ft of the target without disadvantage on your roll.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.text: You know Thieves' Cant and one other language of your choice.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: You can use the weapon mastery properties of two kinds of weapons you're proficient with, swappable on a long rest.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: Bonus action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.text: Bonus action (if you haven't moved this turn; sets your speed to 0 until turn end): advantage on your next attack roll this turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 10, 12, 16.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.text: Forgo Sneak Attack dice to add extra effects (e.g. poison, disarm) to a Sneak Attack hit; save DC = 8 + Dex modifier + proficiency bonus.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.text: Reaction on being hit by an attack you can see: halve the damage (round down).

features.name: Evasion
features.text: On a Dexterity save for half damage, take none on a success and half on a failure (not while incapacitated).

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.text: Treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 for checks using a skill or tool you're proficient with.

features.name: Improved Cunning Strike
features.text: Apply up to two Cunning Strike effects on a single Sneak Attack, paying each die cost.

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.text: New, more powerful Cunning Strike effects become available.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.text: Gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.text: No attack roll can have advantage against you unless you're incapacitated.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.text: On failing a D20 Test, turn it into a 20 instead. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Arcane Trickster
features.text: Enhances stealth and agility with arcane spells for pickpocketing, burglary, or pranks.

features.name: Assassin
features.text: Trained in stealth, poison, and disguise to eliminate foes with deadly efficiency.

features.name: Inquisitive
features.text: Excels at rooting out secrets and reading the intent of others to expose hidden evils.

features.name: Mastermind
features.text: Focuses on people, influence, and secrets — words and favors are the weapons of choice.

features.name: Phantom
features.text: A mystical connection to death, drawing knowledge from the dead and negative energy.

features.name: Scout
features.text: Skilled in stealth and wilderness survival, scouting ahead of companions.

features.name: Soulknife
features.text: Discovers psionic power within, striking foes with blades of pure mental force.

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.text: Trains in the art of the blade, relying on speed, elegance, and charm.

features.name: Thief
features.text: A mix of burglar, treasure hunter, and explorer — the classic adventuring rogue.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You know 4 cantrips and prepare a growing list of level 1+ spells from the Sorcerer list; Charisma is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots per the Sorcerer table, all regained on a long rest.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.text: Bonus action, 2 uses per long rest: for 1 minute, your Sorcerer spells' save DC +1 and advantage on their attack rolls.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.text: Sorcery Points (scaling with level, max per level, all regained on a long rest) can be converted to/from spell slots (up to level 5).

features.name: Metamagic
features.text: Gain 2 Metamagic options (of your choice) to modify spells using Sorcery Points; one option per spell unless noted otherwise. 2 more options at level 10, 2 more at 17.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.text: On a short rest, regain Sorcery Points up to half your Sorcerer level (round down). Once per long rest.

features.name: Sorcery Incarnate
features.text: Spend 2 Sorcery Points to use Innate Sorcery even with no uses left; while it's active, use up to two Metamagic options per spell.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Arcane Apotheosis
features.text: While Innate Sorcery is active, use one Metamagic option each turn for free.

features.name: Aberrant Mind
features.text: An alien influence grants psionic power, letting you touch minds and warp magical energy.

features.name: Clockwork Soul
features.text: The cosmic force of order from Mechanus suffuses you with magic of balance and precision.

features.name: Divine Soul
features.text: Innate magic springs from a distant, powerful connection to a divine being.

features.name: Draconic Bloodline
features.text: Innate magic comes from the gift, blood, or ancestry of a dragon.

features.name: Shadow Magic
features.text: Innate magic comes from the Shadowfell itself, casting a strange pall over your presence.

features.name: Storm Sorcery
features.text: Innate magic comes from the power of elemental air, often tied to a near-death storm.

features.name: Wild Magic
features.text: Innate magic stems from the forces of chaos underlying the order of creation.

features.name: Lunar Sorcery
features.text: Innate magic tied to the phases of the moon, drawn from lunar deities and the waxing/waning cycles of a world's moons.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.text: Gain 1 invocation of your choice (more at higher levels); invocations with prerequisites require qualifying first. Swappable on gaining a Warlock level.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.text: You know 2 cantrips and prepare a growing list of Warlock spells; Charisma is your spellcasting ability. All slots are the same (highest) level available and are regained on a short or long rest — see the pact magic table, not the standard multiclass slot table.

features.name: Magical Cunning
features.text: 1-minute rite (once per long rest): regain expended Pact Magic slots, up to half your maximum (round up).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16.

features.name: Contact Patron
features.text: Always have Contact Other Plane prepared, castable without a slot (automatic save success) once per long rest.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (6th level)
features.text: Choose a level 6 Warlock spell; cast it once per long rest without a slot. More arcana at levels 13 (7th), 15 (8th), 17 (9th).

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat of your choice.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.text: Using Magical Cunning now regains ALL expended Pact Magic slots.

features.name: The Archfey
features.text: Patron is a lord or lady of the fey, a being of legend with inscrutable, sometimes whimsical motives.

features.name: The Celestial
features.text: Patron is a powerful being of the Upper Planes, granting a touch of holy light.

features.name: The Fathomless
features.text: Patron is an entity of the ocean or the Elemental Plane of Water, granting thalassic power.

features.name: The Fiend
features.text: Patron is a fiend from the lower planes, whose aims are evil even if the warlock's are not.

features.name: The Genie
features.text: Bonded to a noble genie and its vessel, an extradimensional space you can enter at will.

features.name: The Great Old One
features.text: Patron is a mysterious entity foreign to reality, perhaps from the Far Realm.

features.name: The Hexblade
features.text: Pact with a Shadowfell entity that manifests in sentient magic weapons.

features.name: The Undead
features.text: Pact with a deathless being that has forsaken its mortal shell to pursue unfathomable ambitions.

features.name: The Undying
features.text: Patron has unlocked the secrets of everlasting life, sharing secrets of life and death.

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.text: With thieves' or artisan's tools in hand, action: touch a Tiny nonmagical object and give it a minor magical property (light, a short recorded message, a sound/odor, or a static visual). Lasts indefinitely; you can affect a number of objects at once equal to your Intelligence modifier (min 1).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You know 2 cantrips and prepare a number of spells equal to Int modifier + half your Artificer level (round down, min 1) from the Artificer list. Must have thieves' or artisan's tools in hand as a spellcasting focus. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. Spell slots per the Artificer table (starting at 1st level), all regained on a long rest.

features.name: Infuse Item
features.text: On a long rest, imbue nonmagical objects with known infusions (turning them into magic items); max simultaneous infusions scales with level. An infusion vanishes if reassigned or if you die (after days equal to your Int modifier, min 1).

features.name: Artificer Specialist
features.text: Choose a specialist (subclass), granting features at 3rd, 5th, 9th, and 15th level.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.text: With thieves' or artisan's tools in hand, spend 1 hour to magically create one set of artisan's tools in an unoccupied space within 5 feet (nonmagical, vanishes when you use this again).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: ASI or feat. Repeats at levels 8, 12, 16, 19.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.text: Double proficiency bonus on ability checks using a tool you're proficient with.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.text: Reaction: add your Intelligence modifier to an ability check or save made by you or a creature within 30 feet. Uses per long rest = Int modifier (min 1).

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.text: Attune to up to 4 magic items; crafting common/uncommon items costs a quarter the time and half the gold.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.text: On a long rest, store a 1st- or 2nd-level action-cast Artificer spell in a weapon or spellcasting focus; anyone holding it can use an action to trigger it, using your spellcasting modifier, for twice your Int modifier's worth of uses (min 2).

features.name: Magic Item Savant
features.text: Attune to up to 5 magic items; ignore class/race/spell/level requirements to attune to or use a magic item.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.text: Attune to up to 6 magic items.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.text: +1 to all saving throws per magic item currently attuned; reaction on dropping to 0 HP: end an infusion to drop to 1 HP instead.

features.name: Alchemist
features.text: Combines reagents to produce mystical effects — the oldest artificer tradition, valued for both healing and harm.

features.name: Armorer
features.text: Modifies armor into a second skin, bonding with it to hone magic, unleash attacks, and form a defense.

features.name: Artillerist
features.text: Specializes in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions across a battlefield.

features.name: Battle Smith
features.text: A protector and medic, expert at defending others and repairing material and personnel, aided by a steel defender companion.
